headline: Morocco and Belgium Sign Pact to Upgrade Industrial Maintenance Expertise
summary: Morocco's Cluster Maintenance 4.0 signed a strategic letter of intent with Belgium's Maintenance Association in Antwerp. The partnership targets industrial reliability, knowledge sharing, and technical exchanges.
why: Morocco is rapidly expanding its industrial manufacturing ecosystem across automotive, aerospace, and chemical processing sectors.

impacts.name: Morocco
impacts.why: Cross-border industrial partnerships enhance technical expertise and factory operational efficiency.
